اصطفيا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَفَيَا (iṣṭafayā) /isˤ.tˤa.fa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# اُصْطُفِيَا (uṣṭufiyā) /usˤ.tˤu.fi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# اِصْطَفِيَا (iṣṭafiyā) /isˤ.tˤa.fi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
